scenes.say: One win in Saturday's sprint, and Marc Márquez is MotoGP champion for the eighth time.
Márquez has four hundred thirty-one points. Jorge Martín is sixty behind, Marco Bezzecchi seventy-four.
Two weekends left, Portugal and Valencia. That's seventy-four points on the table.
A sprint win is worth twelve points, the Sunday race twenty-five.
If the sprint goes wrong, fourteen points across the Portimão weekend will still do it.
In Qatar he won the sprint, then chose not to take risks and finished second to Bezzecchi.
MotoGP standings and the Portugal schedule are on LapRadar.

title: Márquez one step from an eighth MotoGP title: what he needs in Portugal
